title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 5, Part 20 - State Retirement System (Maine Public Employees Retirement System)
verified_how: Fetched title5ch0sec0.html, which lists 'Part 20: State Retirement System (Chapters 421-427, §17001-§18806)' and, separately, 'Part 21: Social Security for State and Municipal Employees'; then title5ch421sec0.html, which prints 'Title 5, Chapter 421: GENERAL PROVISIONS' with subchapters Definitions, General Policies and Intent, Establishment and Administration, Financing, Appeals. Data extracted 10/23/2025; Titles index gives the text as current through October 1, 2025.
notes: This is the state-law layer (MainePERS, covering state employees, teachers, participating local districts, judicial and legislative retirement). The federal-state Social Security coverage agreement for state and municipal employees is the adjacent 5 M.R.S. Part 21. Federal OASDI itself is 42 U.S.C. ch.7 and private occupational pensions are pre-empted by ERISA (29 U.S.C. 1001).
